name: ShroudForge No Resource Cost
description: Removes recipe resource costs through keen::RecipeRegistryResource.

changelog: Added a declarative overview page for the Modloader UI.
Added independent item, energy, and water cost controls.

settingGroups.label: Recipe costs
settingGroups.description: Choose which supported recipe costs are set to zero during the pregame phase.

settings.label: Remove item costs
settings.description: Sets supported recipe input stack counts to zero.

settings.label: Remove energy costs
settings.description: Sets supported requiredEnergy fields to zero.

settings.label: Remove water costs
settings.description: Sets supported waterAmount and waterCharges fields to zero.

components.label: Pregame transformation
components.text: The mod edits the selected recipe registry fields before gameplay.
Selected recipe input counts, energy requirements, water amounts, and water charges are set to zero for the current session.

components.label: Restart required
components.text: Install or remove this mod before launching the game so the recipe resources are rebuilt cleanly.
